name: shadPS4 guest user area reservation at USER_MIN (Linux x86-64 configuration: USER_MIN=0x1000000000, USER_MAX=0x54FFFFFFFFFF)
required_postconditions: the guest user area occupies exactly [USER_MIN, USER_MAX] with no host object inside it
every guest pointer in the user area is dereferenced directly as a host pointer

failure_sink.description: if any of the three reservation mmaps returns MAP_FAILED the constructor logs LOG_CRITICAL(Kernel_Vmm, "mmap failed: {}") at line 679 and executes `throw std::bad_alloc{}` at line 680. NOTE: this is a throw, not an ASSERT. The ASSERT_MSG sinks in this file guard the *per-mapping* path (ASSERT_MSG(ret != MAP_FAILED) at line 753 in Impl::Map, line 775 in Impl::Unmap, line 792 in Impl::Protect), not this reservation. The reservation path also never compares the returned pointer to the requested address: lines 677-678 test only `== MAP_FAILED`.

source_locations.symbol: map_flags = MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED (destructive; no MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE appears anywhere in the tree)
Impl::Impl - single combined mmap at SYSTEM_MANAGED_MIN covering managed+reserved+user
user_base = reinterpret_cast<u8*>(USER_MIN) - identity is asserted by construction, never verified
